description: This PHP class 'LeaveRequestComment' represents an entity in a Human Resource Management system, specifically modeling comments made on leave requests. It includes ORM mapping annotations for database integration and methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: LeaveRequestComment
classes.description: Entity class representing comments associated with leave requests within the HRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates a LeaveRequest entity with this comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with the creator of the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the creator of the comment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the text of the comment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the text of the comment.
